notes.title: 1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
[u][b]New Features[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Line Renderer for Cue Ball slightly adjusted for clarity
[*] Added a loss message to Tournament
[*] Added an indicator to the Main Menu to show that a Tournament is in progress
[*] Additional SFX added (ball clack on character select, multiple clacks during Tournament fighting animations, cheering when a Tournament is successfully completed
[*] Tournament now autosaves between each match
[*] Pause menu is now disabled after a match is ended
[/list]

[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Intro ball clacking sound no longer disregards audio settings upon starting the game
[*] Fixed issue where a charged shot from one game could be carried over to a new game by pausing during the charge and cancelling out to the Main Menu
[*] "Winner (by default)" text is no longer always the game over text regardless of actual game end conditions
[*] On the game end screen, the "Press A to continue" text no longer shows a controller A button regardless of the actual controller being used
[*] Fixed issue where character unlocked screen (at end of Tournament) was being skipped over automatically
[*] Tournament no longer freezes up when continuing from saved data
[*] Fixed UI misalignment that occurred right after a resolution change
[*] Top-down camera for full billiard table now scales better on different resolutions
[*] Ball characters hands are no longer visible at the top of Tournament screen (mainly occurred in 4:3 resolutions)
[*] Pause menu UI adjusted to better fit different resolutions
[*] Cancelling out of Settings menu no longer skips to Start Screen and goes to Main Menu instead
[*] Fixed issue where selecting a character with the mouse and then using the arrow keys to navigate the character select would desync the selection
[/list]
